description: Head-movement mini-game GA20, Group D (fun finale) and series finale: a daily routine stringing the A-group moves together in 5 fixed segments — 3 nods, alternating turns left/right x2, ear-to-shoulder holds 3 s each side, up/down stretch holds 3 s each, 2 chin tucks — each segment return-gated, 30 s per-segment skip rule, three-prompt calibration (down, left turn, left tilt). Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: daily-routine
